svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print a block 36 x 56 x 75 mm with an 18 mm hole across its

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 36 mm thickness, centred, 40 mm below the top face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print it standing on its 36 x 56 end so the hole axis is

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: horizontal; six walls so screws bite in solid plastic.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: pressed into the top of each arm, top faces flush; the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bronze bush passes through arm side, plug and arm side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill the bolt holes (gearbox, latch, spring can) through the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plug from the arm's holes once it is in place.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The plug spreads the bolt loads and keeps the thin tube walls

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a firm press fit; the hole lines up with the arm's 18 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: holes so the bush slides through.
